instructions.name: buy
docs: Buy tokens on the constant-product AMM (mints SPL).

accounts.name: buyer_ata
docs: Buyer ATA — created if needed.

instructions.name: graduate_curve
docs: Permissionless: mark curve complete when real_sol ≥ GRADUATE_REAL_SOL.
Raydium migration is a stub — vault accounting remains on-chain.

instructions.name: initialize_oracle_config
docs: Bootstrap oracle config. Default quorum = 3 (pass `Some(1)` for local mock).

instructions.name: initialize_token
docs: Called via CPI from NarrativeAuction::graduate_narrative.
Creates SPL mint (authority = curve) + curve vault + curve ATA.
`TokenParams.base_price` / `curve_k` → virtual_sol / virtual_token (0 = Pump defaults).

instructions.name: mint_staker_airdrop
docs: Mint reserved staker-airdrop into escrow ATA + apply seed SOL as AMM buy.

accounts.name: airdrop_vault
docs: Destination ATA (typically owned by NarrativeAuction StakeAirdrop PDA).

instructions.name: repair_curve
docs: Repair / migrate curve to Pump CPMM virtual reserves (creator-only).
`base_price`/`curve_k` args = virtual_sol / virtual_token (0 = defaults).

instructions.name: sell
docs: Sell tokens with attention-dependent tax (burns SPL).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent if absorber vault must be created.

instructions.name: update_attention
docs: Oracle crank — EMA update. Tx-signer quorum or ed25519 proof mode.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Fee-paying cranker / keeper. Counted toward quorum if authorized (signer mode).

accounts.name: instructions_sysvar
docs: Pass the sysvar address always; ignored when `proof` is empty.

errors.name: CurveComplete
errors.msg: Bonding curve complete — trading moved to AMM migrate

errors.name: GraduationThresholdNotMet
errors.msg: Real SOL below bonding-curve graduation threshold

errors.name: InvalidOracleWeights
errors.msg: Oracle weights must sum to 10000 bps

errors.name: InsufficientOracleQuorum
errors.msg: Insufficient distinct authorized oracle signers for quorum

errors.name: DuplicateOracle
errors.msg: Duplicate oracle signer in attestation set

errors.name: OracleNotSigner
errors.msg: Oracle remaining account is not a signer

errors.name: OracleNotFound
errors.msg: Oracle not found in authorized set

errors.name: InvalidQuorum
errors.msg: Quorum must be between 1 and authorized oracle count

errors.name: OracleRemovalBreaksQuorum
errors.msg: Cannot remove oracle: would drop below quorum

errors.name: MintMismatch
errors.msg: Mint account does not match curve.mint

errors.name: SettlementOverflow
errors.msg: Settlement amounts exceed target reserve / vault

errors.name: AirdropSupplyNotZero
errors.msg: Staker airdrop requires mint.supply == 0 (call right after initialize_token)

errors.name: AirdropTooLarge
errors.msg: Airdrop amount exceeds notional total supply

fields.name: oracle_count
docs: Number of distinct authorized oracle signers that attested this update.

types.name: HolderPosition
docs: Per-holder position — tracks reward-index / claimable alongside SPL balances.
Seeds = [b"holder", curve, owner]

fields.name: lore_power
docs: Governance weight for LoreMerge votes.

fields.name: reward_debt
docs: Reward index snapshot (debt) for pro-rata sell-tax claims.

fields.name: claimable_rewards
docs: Claimable lamports from redistributed sell tax.

types.name: OracleConfig
docs: Oracle network config — Phase-1 mainnet: N-of-M multi-sig crank (default 3/5).
Seeds = [b"oracle-config"]

fields.name: update_interval
docs: Target update interval (e.g. 300s = 5 min).

fields.name: twitter_weight
docs: Weights in bps of 10_000 (default 4000 / 3000 / 3000).

fields.name: quorum
docs: Required distinct authorized oracle signers per `update_attention` (default 3).

types.name: TokenParams
docs: CPI / init params — field order must stay wire-compatible with
NarrativeAuction `TokenParamsWire`.
Semantics (Pump CPMM):
- `base_price` → initial `virtual_sol` (lamports); 0 = use INITIAL_VIRTUAL_SOL
- `curve_k` → initial `virtual_token` (whole); 0 = use INITIAL_VIRTUAL_TOKEN
- `initial_liquidity` → seed SOL from narrative stakes (applied as Δx buy)

types.name: VelocityToken
docs: Constant-product bonding curve state (Pump.fun–style).
Seeds = [b"curve", story_id]
Wire layout: first fields keep historical offsets (virtual_sol was base_price,
virtual_token was curve_k, real_sol was sol_reserve). New fields append.

fields.name: story_id
docs: Link back to NarrativeAuction StoryMarket.

fields.name: virtual_sol
docs: Virtual SOL reserves (lamports). Was `base_price`.

fields.name: current_supply
docs: Whole tokens sold / circulating from the curve (airdrop + buys − sells).

fields.name: current_price
docs: Spot = virtual_sol / virtual_token (lamports per whole token).

fields.name: attention_score
docs: EMA-smoothed attention score (oracle) — drives sell tax only.

fields.name: price_velocity
docs: Moving average of price change.

fields.name: virtual_token
docs: Virtual token reserves (whole tokens). Was `curve_k`.

fields.name: sell_tax_bps
docs: Dynamic 500–1500 bps (attention steepen / flatten).

fields.name: merge_count
docs: How many narratives absorbed via LoreMerge.

fields.name: real_sol
docs: Real SOL held from buys / seed (lamports). Was `sol_reserve`.

fields.name: protocol_fees
docs: Accumulated protocol fees (lamports) still in vault.

fields.name: holder_rewards_pool
docs: Sell-tax share reserved for holders (lamports) still in vault.

fields.name: reward_index
docs: Cumulative reward index (scaled by REWARD_SCALE in math).

fields.name: last_price
docs: Previous spot price for velocity MA.

fields.name: seed_liquidity
docs: SOL seeded at narrative graduate (stake principal + 80% losing).

fields.name: real_token
docs: Remaining real tokens available to sell on the curve (whole).

fields.name: complete
docs: Bonding curve complete (real_sol ≥ GRADUATE_REAL_SOL). Raydium migrate stub.
